extras.textures: PBR 2048px: base color, roughness, metallic, normal (baked)
extras.real_size: personal watercraft (jet ski), approx. 3.2 x 1.2 x 1.1 m (L x W x H)
extras.notes: bow faces -Y; sits on its keel at z = 0, add your own water (waterline at 0.24 m: blue boot stripe above the antifouling); separate moving parts with origin on their axis: jet-ski_handlebar (turns around the inclined steering column, axis direction (0, -0.41, 0.91)), jet-ski_jet_nozzle (swivels around Z); no brand, no text, no registration number

origin.detail: Built procedurally with Blender scripts. The scripts were written with the help of an AI coding assistant. No generative AI model produced the geometry or textures directly.
